title: Measure a retriever over a markdown corpus

exports.name: build_index
exports.description: Build a searchable index over a list of documents, each carrying an id and text.

exports.name: search
exports.signature: search(index: dict, query: str, k: int) -> list[str]
exports.description: Return the ids of the k highest scoring documents for a query, best first.

exports.name: recall_at_k
exports.signature: recall_at_k(ranked_ids: list[str], relevant_ids: set[str], k: int) -> float
exports.description: Fraction of the relevant documents that appear in the first k results.

exports.name: ndcg_at_k
exports.signature: ndcg_at_k(ranked_ids: list[str], relevance: dict[str, int], k: int) -> float
exports.description: Discounted cumulative gain over the first k results, normalised against the ideal ordering.

exports.name: reciprocal_rank
exports.description: One divided by the rank of the first relevant result, or zero when none is relevant.
